title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: suggested prompts and a prompt library for Champion connectors
notes: claim 50: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The roadmap facts, connector licensing and documented control operations check out, and targeted searches found no published Champion prompt switch or default. The assurance that Copilot's data reach does not change should be narrowed to what the roadmap describes; the connector deployment and inventory routes also need clarification.

claims.claim: Copilot > Connectors > Connectors > Gallery > data source in the Microsoft 365 admin center opens connector setup.
claims.quote: In the left pane, choose Copilot > Connectors. On the Connectors tab, in the left pane, choose Gallery, and select the data source you want to connect
claims.fix: The route reaches the correct setup page but stops before deploying the connection. Extend controls[1].ui.path to 'Copilot > Connectors > Connectors > Gallery > data source > authentication method > Create', using 'authentication method' as the choice placeholder. The cited deployment overview instructs the admin to choose an authentication method and then choose Create to deploy the connection.

claims.claim: Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses is the admin center route to assign a user's licence.
